title: ql_apply.plain_question leaves path.md:12:34 a path:line citation, so the guard rejects a real question's gap
goal: plain_question removes every line number of a path:line citation in a logged question, including a doubled one such as docs/a.md:12:34, so no check.LEDGER_CITE match is left and the gap step files the entry instead of rejecting it

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import ql_apply,check;sys.exit(0 if check.LEDGER_CITE.search(ql_apply.plain_question('see docs/a.md:12:34 here')) is None else 1)
